correctness.rationale: The mod-two recurrence fixes the full kernel as 0 plus three period-three masks at divisible lengths. Simultaneous adjacency avoidance forces each collision pair to be 0,b,1-b blocks, whose local readout gives fixed-one positions and one global parity condition. Two choices of b yield each target, the three target languages intersect only at 1^n, and the last element of its unrestricted affine coset is inadmissible. The Lucas trace identity then proves all exact fiber populations and image size. verify.py exhaustively checks n=3..18 and identities n=3..300; computation is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact local parity-readout inverse-fiber law produces a finite-length optimal distinguishable codebook size, a complete O(n) ambiguity test and list decoder, and a sharp exceptional 3-divisibility transition. It distinguishes noiseless identifiable sources from a unique three-to-one output and shows exponentially vanishing ambiguity under the natural uniform constrained-source model. These exact quantities are directly motivated in constrained sensing/coding, beyond routine parameter substitution.
